manifest.title: Answer a planning question
manifest.action: Clarify hours, staffing, qualifications or escalation; answers are saved before AI runs.

manifest.title: Candidate plan ready for review
manifest.action: A completed AI job produces a proposal and still requires human review.

manifest.title: Inspect the unapplied AI candidate
manifest.action: Check sources and proposed staffing before applying an unconfirmed draft.

manifest.title: Apply the reviewed draft
manifest.action: Applying a candidate creates an unconfirmed draft; verification remains a separate human step.

manifest.title: Verify the operating plan
manifest.action: Confirm the reviewed operating records and verify the model before recruitment.

manifest.title: Map with positioned posts
manifest.action: View areas, staffing posts and check-in zones on a site plan.

manifest.title: Edit an area on the map
manifest.action: Review the location position, radius and details before saving.

manifest.title: Add or correct a location
manifest.action: Use the manual editor to make the operating plan accurate.

manifest.title: Edit the volunteer procedure
manifest.action: Keep the briefing concise and state who owns escalation decisions.

manifest.title: Generate shift times
manifest.action: Start from the verified operating windows and choose a shift length.

manifest.title: Review the shift draft
manifest.action: See staffing requirements and any unfilled places before assigning crew.

manifest.title: Review the assigned candidate
manifest.action: Deterministic assignment checks availability, qualifications and coverage.

manifest.title: Confirm roster publication
manifest.action: Confirm that reviewed assignments should be shared with volunteers.

manifest.title: Roster published
manifest.action: Crew can now view their own assignments.

manifest.title: Crowd estimates on the site map
manifest.action: Read density estimates alongside their site location and freshness.

manifest.title: Review modelled weather
manifest.action: Read current advisory conditions and check local procedures.

manifest.title: Review rest and break rules
manifest.action: Set scheduling limits before generating assignments.

manifest.title: Log in after email confirmation
manifest.action: Return after confirming the signup email and enter your email.

manifest.title: Authenticate
manifest.action: Enter your password to continue. The password is masked.

manifest.title: Acknowledge the instruction
manifest.action: Tell the coordinator you accepted the task.

manifest.title: Travel to the destination
manifest.action: Update your progress when you are on the way.

manifest.title: Confirm arrival
manifest.action: Arrival tells the coordinator the response is on site.

manifest.title: Finish the response task
manifest.action: Mark the task complete and await further instructions.

manifest.title: Check out after the shift
manifest.action: Finish the assignment and keep attendance accurate.

manifest.title: Evidence saved; review required
manifest.action: The original is saved; extracted fields require human review before qualification use.

manifest.title: Record a voice incident
manifest.action: Speak the location, what happened and anything urgent. Browser microphone input is simulated.

manifest.title: Review the voice report before sending
manifest.action: Add written context if helpful. This capture does not send or transcribe the recording.

manifest.title: Optional phone alerts
manifest.action: Enable alerts in an installed mobile build; web screenshots show the settings only.

manifest.title: Confirm response completion
manifest.action: Review field updates and record completion notes.

manifest.title: Review the event summary
manifest.action: Edit the AI draft, confirm follow-up and close the event yourself.

manifest.title: Event closed
manifest.action: Event closeout is confirmed while the operational record remains available.
